# MilPayTools
> Free military pay and benefits calculators built on official 2026 DoD and VA data. No account required. No personal info needed to use the tools — calculator inputs are never sent to our servers. We use privacy-respecting analytics; see our Privacy Policy.

## Calculators (18)
- [Total Military Compensation](/calculators/total-compensation): Full pay breakdown with BAH, BAS, tax advantages, TSP match, TRICARE healthcare value, and civilian salary equivalent — including what a civilian would need to earn to match your total package
- [BAH Calculator](/calculators/bah): 2026 BAH rates for all 40,959 ZIP codes
- [VA Disability Rating](/calculators/va-disability): Combined rating calculator with bilateral factor and 2026 compensation rates
- [TSP Growth Projector](/calculators/tsp): Retirement savings projections with fund allocation
- [Military Retirement](/calculators/retirement): High-3 and BRS pension projections with lifetime value
- [PCS Cost Estimator](/calculators/pcs): DLA, MALT, per diem, TLE, and PPM profit estimates
- [Guard/Reserve Pay](/calculators/guard-reserve): Drill pay, annual training, and TRICARE Reserve Select
- [Education Benefits](/calculators/education): GI Bill vs VR&E vs TA comparison by school
- [CONUS COLA](/calculators/cola): Cost of living allowance lookup by ZIP
- [Compare Your PCS Move](/calculators/compare): Side-by-side BAH, taxes, COLA, and take-home between current and new station
- [Deployment Pay](/calculators/deployment): Combat zone tax exclusion and special pays
- [2026 Pay Charts](/calculators/pay-charts): Full pay tables for all ranks and years of service
- [Dual Military BAH](/calculators/dual-military-bah): BAH scenarios for military couples
- [Transition Readiness](/calculators/transition-readiness): Am I financially ready to leave the military?
- [Separation Benefits Timeline](/calculators/separation-timeline): When each benefit stops, converts, or expires after separation
- [Healthcare Cost Comparison](/calculators/healthcare-comparison): TRICARE vs civilian healthcare cost comparison
- [VA Loan Payment Calculator](/calculators/va-loan): VA loan monthly payment estimator with funding fee calculation, disability exemption waiver, and BAH comparison — educational only, no rate quotes
- [VA Refinance Calculator](/calculators/va-refinance): IRRRL and cash-out refinance savings estimator, monthly savings, break-even point, and VA net tangible benefit requirement checks

## Guides (9)
- [Starting Service: Military Pay & Benefits from Day One](/guides/starting-service): New service member guide — total compensation, BAH, TSP enrollment, LES, and first-year financial checkpoints
- [Navigating Service: PCS, Deployment & Duty Station Financial Tools](/guides/navigating-service): PCS orders, deployment pay, PCS pay comparison, and longer-term financial planning for active-duty service members mid-career
- [Military Pay & Compensation Guide](/guides/military-pay): Understanding base pay, BAH, BAS, tax advantages, and total compensation
- [PCS & Duty Station Financial Guide](/guides/pcs): DLA, MALT, per diem, TLE, PPM, and duty station cost comparison tools
- [VA Disability Benefits Guide](/guides/va-disability): Combined rating formula, bilateral factor, 2026 compensation rates, CRDP and CRSC
- [Military Retirement & TSP Guide](/guides/retirement-tsp): High-3 vs BRS, TSP strategy, Roth vs Traditional, pension and retirement income
- [Military Education Benefits Guide](/guides/education-benefits): GI Bill, VR&E, TA, and Montgomery GI Bill comparison and sequencing strategy
- [VA Home Loans Guide 2026](/guides/va-home-loans): VA loan eligibility, funding fee table, disability exemption waiver, BAH as mortgage income, and payment calculator
- [Military Transition Financial Roadmap](/transition): Full financial arc of military separation — income, healthcare, benefits, and deadlines

- [For Partners](/partners): Partner page for sharing MilPayTools with audiences, organized by military life stage — Starting Service, Pay & Housing, PCS & Relocation, Deployment, Retirement & TSP, Education & Career, VA Loans, Veterans Benefits, and Leaving the Military. Links to all 18 calculators, 9 guides, and key blog posts. Designed for sharing with service members, veterans, military families, transition coaches, and veteran organizations. No accounts, no personal info, no ads.

## Pay by Rank

- [Military Pay by Rank](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay): Index page for per-rank pay pages — basic pay progression by years of service plus BAH, BAS, and total compensation for every enlisted and officer grade.

- [E-1 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e1): Entry pay grade. Flat basic pay rate, the under-4-months footnote rate, first-paycheck mechanics, and the in-kind housing/meals reality for new members.

- [E-2 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e2): Single flat rate with no longevity steps. Automatic-advancement timeline and how the early TSP default settings work.

- [E-3 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e3): First grade with longevity steps. BRS match vesting at two years and total compensation with BAH and BAS.

- [E-4 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e4): The cusp grade before the NCO track. Five longevity steps and the first BAH-as-cash move for many members.

- [E-5 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e5): First NCO grade in most branches. Full pay progression through 12 years, worked total-compensation example, and promotion timelines.

- [E-6 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e6): Mid-career NCO grade. Eleven longevity steps to over 18 years and the compounding TSP decade.

- [E-7 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e7): Senior NCO threshold. Pay progression to over 26 years and the 20-year pension decision zone.

- [E-8 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e8): Pay table starts at over 8 years. Longevity steps through over 30 years and High-3 pension mechanics.

- [E-9 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/e9): Top enlisted grade; table starts at over 10 years with the longest enlisted longevity run.

- [O-1 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o1): Entry officer grade. Short table, the over-3 jump, and the O-1E prior-enlisted scale explained.

- [O-2 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o2): Second company-grade rank with the steepest percentage steps in the officer chart, plus the O-2E scale.

- [O-3 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o3): The workhorse officer grade. Nine longevity steps to over 14 years, stay-or-go math, and the O-3E scale.

- [O-4 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o4): First field grade. Promotion-driven raises and the table through over 18 years.

- [O-5 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o5): The command grade. Thirteen longevity steps to over 22 years and where the High-3 average typically forms.

- [O-6 Pay 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/pay/o6): Senior field grade and terminal rank for most officers. The longest officer pay table, running to over 30 years.

## BAH by Duty Station

- [BAH Rates by Military Installation](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah): Index page with search and filter for all duty station BAH pages. Find any installation by name, city, state, or branch.

- [Fort Bragg](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-bragg): Fayetteville, NC — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the 82nd Airborne Division's home station, the largest U.S. military installation by population.

- [Fort Campbell](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-campbell): Clarksville, TN — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault), straddling the Kentucky-Tennessee border.

- [Fort Hood](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-hood): Killeen, TX — Army. 2026 BAH rates for one of the most affordable large military markets in the country, home to III Armored Corps.

- [Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM)](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-lewis-mcchord): Lakewood, WA — Army/Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the largest military installation on the West Coast; CONUS COLA added for this area in 2026.

- [Fort Carson](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-carson): Colorado Springs, CO — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 4th Infantry Division at the base of Pikes Peak.

- [Fort Drum](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-drum): Watertown, NY — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 10th Mountain Division in upstate New York.

- [Fort Bliss](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-bliss): El Paso, TX — Army. 2026 BAH rates for one of the most affordable major housing markets in the country, home to the 1st Armored Division.

- [Fort Stewart](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-stewart): Hinesville, GA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the largest Army installation east of the Mississippi River, home to the 3rd Infantry Division.

- [Fort Knox](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-knox): Radcliff, KY — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of Armor School and the U.S. Army Human Resources Command.

- [Fort Riley](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-riley): Junction City, KS — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 1st Infantry Division ("Big Red One") in north-central Kansas.

- [Fort Benning](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-benning): Columbus, GA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Maneuver Center of Excellence and Ranger Training Brigade.

- [Fort Gordon](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-gordon): Augusta, GA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the U.S. Army Cyber Center of Excellence and Signal Corps.

- [Fort Sill](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-sill): Lawton, OK — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the Field Artillery School; one of the most affordable military housing markets in the country.

- [Fort Leavenworth](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-leavenworth): Leavenworth, KS — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Command and General Staff College; falls within the Kansas City MHA.

- [Fort Huachuca](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-huachuca): Sierra Vista, AZ — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the U.S. Army Intelligence Center of Excellence in southeastern Arizona.

- [Fort Wainwright](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-wainwright): Fairbanks, AK — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the coldest major U.S. military installation, home to the 1st Brigade Combat Team (Stryker), 25th Infantry Division.

- [Fort Polk](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-polk): Leesville, LA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Joint Readiness Training Center (JRTC) installation in western Louisiana.

- [Schofield Barracks](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/schofield-barracks): Wahiawa, HI — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 25th Infantry Division on Oahu; among the highest BAH rates in the DoD.

- [Aberdeen Proving Ground](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/aberdeen-proving-ground): Aberdeen, MD — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Army's primary research and testing center; falls within the Baltimore MHA.

- [Redstone Arsenal](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/redstone-arsenal): Huntsville, AL — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Army Aviation and Missile Command center in Huntsville's technology corridor.

- [Fort Hamilton](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-hamilton): Brooklyn, NY — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the only active-duty military installation in New York City; NYC MHA rates apply.

- [Fort George G. Meade](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-meade): Odenton, MD — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of NSA and U.S. Cyber Command; falls within the Baltimore MHA.

- [Fort Jackson](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-jackson): Columbia, SC — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Army's largest initial entry training center in the affordable Columbia market.

- [Fort Detrick](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-detrick): Frederick, MD — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the U.S. Army Medical Research and Development Command; falls within the DC-area BAH zone.

- [Fort Irwin (National Training Center)](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/fort-irwin): Barstow, CA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Army's premier large-scale combat training center in the Mojave Desert.

- [United States Military Academy at West Point](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/west-point): West Point, NY — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the nation's premier military university; falls within the New York City metro MHA.

- [Joint Base San Antonio](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-san-antonio): San Antonio, TX — Air Force/Multi-branch. 2026 BAH rates for the largest joint base in the DoD; one of the most affordable large metros in the country.

- [Travis AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/travis-afb): Fairfield, CA — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the Air Force's largest air mobility wing, positioned between San Francisco and Sacramento.

- [MacDill AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/macdill-afb): Tampa, FL — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the home of CENTCOM and SOCSOUTH in the rapidly growing Tampa Bay market.

- [Eglin AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/eglin-afb): Fort Walton Beach, FL — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the largest Air Force base by area in CONUS, in Florida's panhandle.

- [Joint Base Langley-Eustis](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-langley-eustis): Hampton, VA — Air Force/Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of Air Combat Command headquarters in the Hampton Roads market.

- [Wright-Patterson AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/wright-patterson-afb): Dayton, OH — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for Air Force Materiel Command headquarters in Dayton's highly affordable market.

- [Scott AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/scott-afb): O'Fallon, IL — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for U.S. Transportation Command headquarters east of St. Louis in an affordable market.

- [Luke AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/luke-afb): Glendale, AZ — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the world's largest fighter pilot training base in the western Phoenix metro.

- [Davis-Monthan AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/davis-monthan-afb): Tucson, AZ — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 355th Wing and the famous aircraft "boneyard" (AMARG) in the Tucson market.

- [Vandenberg Space Force Base](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/vandenberg-sfb): Lompoc, CA — Space Force/Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the primary West Coast space launch facility; BAH reflects the Santa Barbara MHA.

- [Edwards AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/edwards-afb): Lancaster, CA — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the Air Force Flight Test Center in the Antelope Valley high desert northeast of Los Angeles.

- [Tinker AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/tinker-afb): Midwest City, OK — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the Air Force Sustainment Center in the affordable Oklahoma City metro.

- [Barksdale AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/barksdale-afb): Bossier City, LA — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for Global Strike Command's nuclear bomber headquarters in northwest Louisiana's affordable market.

- [Seymour Johnson AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/seymour-johnson-afb): Goldsboro, NC — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the home of the 4th Fighter Wing and F-15E Strike Eagles in eastern North Carolina.

- [Ellsworth AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/ellsworth-afb): Rapid City, SD — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the 28th Bomb Wing (B-1B Lancer) near the Black Hills; no state income tax on military pay.

- [Minot AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/minot-afb): Minot, ND — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the dual-mission B-52H and ICBM base; one of the most affordable military markets in the country.

- [Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-elmendorf-richardson): Anchorage, AK — Air Force/Army. 2026 BAH rates for the primary military installation in Alaska, home to the 3rd Wing and 11th Airborne Division.

- [Joint Base Andrews](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-andrews): Camp Springs, MD — Air Force/Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of Air Force One in the high-cost DC metro MHA.

- [Kirtland AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/kirtland-afb): Albuquerque, NM — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center and Sandia National Laboratories in an affordable market.

- [Whiteman AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/whiteman-afb): Warrensburg, MO — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for the only B-2 Spirit stealth bomber base; one of the most affordable markets among Air Force installations.

- [Offutt AFB](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/offutt-afb): Bellevue, NE — Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for U.S. Strategic Command (STRATCOM) headquarters in the stable Omaha market.

- [Patrick Space Force Base](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/patrick-sfb): Cocoa Beach, FL — Space Force/Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for Space Launch Delta 45 on Florida's Space Coast near Cape Canaveral.

- [Naval Station Norfolk](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-station-norfolk): Norfolk, VA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the largest naval base in the world; Hampton Roads is a major military housing market with competitive rates.

- [Naval Station San Diego](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-station-san-diego): San Diego, CA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the primary Pacific Fleet surface ship homeport; among the most expensive military markets in CONUS.

- [Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/camp-pendleton): Oceanside, CA — Marine Corps. 2026 BAH rates for the largest active-duty Marine Corps base on the West Coast; San Diego MHA rates apply.

- [Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/camp-lejeune): Jacksonville, NC — Marine Corps/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the primary East Coast amphibious assault training base in an affordable military-dominated market.

- [Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-pearl-harbor-hickam): Honolulu, HI — Navy/Air Force. 2026 BAH rates for Pacific Fleet and Pacific Air Forces headquarters; highest BAH rates in the DoD.

- [Naval Air Station Pensacola](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-air-station-pensacola): Pensacola, FL — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the "Cradle of Naval Aviation" and Blue Angels home base on the Florida Gulf Coast.

- [Naval Station Mayport](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-station-mayport): Atlantic Beach, FL — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the third-largest U.S. Navy fleet concentration area near Jacksonville, Florida.

- [Naval Base Kitsap](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-base-kitsap): Bremerton, WA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for one of the largest naval installations in the world, homeporting Ohio-class submarines on Puget Sound.

- [Naval Air Station Whidbey Island](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-air-station-whidbey-island): Oak Harbor, WA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the EA-18G Growler and P-8 Poseidon base; tied to the Seattle MHA with favorable BAH-to-rent ratio on the island.

- [MCAS Miramar](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/marine-corps-air-station-miramar): San Diego, CA — Marine Corps. 2026 BAH rates for Marine Aircraft Group 11 in the northern San Diego metro (San Diego MHA).

- [MCAS Cherry Point](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/marine-corps-air-station-cherry-point): Havelock, NC — Marine Corps/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the largest Marine Corps air station on the East Coast in an affordable coastal North Carolina market.

- [Marine Corps Base Quantico](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/marine-corps-base-quantico): Quantico, VA — Marine Corps/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the "Crossroads of the Marine Corps"; falls within the high-cost DC metro MHA.

- [Naval Station Great Lakes](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-station-great-lakes): North Chicago, IL — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the Navy's only boot camp and largest training installation on Lake Michigan.

- [Joint Base Little Creek-Fort Story](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-little-creek-fort-story): Virginia Beach, VA — Navy/Army. 2026 BAH rates for the home of Navy Expeditionary Combat Command and SEAL Team Six on the Virginia Beach oceanfront.

- [Naval Submarine Base New London](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-submarine-base-new-london): Groton, CT — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the U.S. Navy's primary submarine base and Naval Submarine School on the Thames River.

- [MCAS Beaufort](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/marine-corps-air-station-beaufort): Beaufort, SC — Marine Corps/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the F-35B operational base in South Carolina's Lowcountry.

- [Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-mcguire-dix-lakehurst): Wrightstown, NJ — Air Force/Army/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the only U.S. base hosting all three Total Force components; Philadelphia/South Jersey MHA.

- [Naval Air Station Oceana](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-air-station-oceana): Virginia Beach, VA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the East Coast Master Jet Base and primary F/A-18 strike fighter training pipeline.

- [Naval Base Ventura County](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-base-ventura-county): Port Hueneme, CA — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for NAS Point Mugu and the Pacific Seabees in Southern California's Ventura County.

- [MCAGCC Twentynine Palms](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/marine-corps-air-ground-combat-center): Twentynine Palms, CA — Marine Corps. 2026 BAH rates for the world's largest Marine Corps base and combined-arms training center in the Mojave Desert.

- [Naval Station Newport](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/naval-station-newport): Newport, RI — Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the Naval War College and Surface Warfare Officers School on Aquidneck Island in Rhode Island.

- [Joint Base Myer-Henderson Hall](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-myer-henderson-hall): Arlington, VA — Army. 2026 BAH rates for the Pentagon-adjacent installation home of the Old Guard; DC metro MHA with very high rates.

- [Joint Base Charleston](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-charleston): North Charleston, SC — Air Force/Navy. 2026 BAH rates for the 437th Airlift Wing and primary East Coast port of embarkation.

- [Joint Base Cape Cod](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/joint-base-cape-cod): Bourne, MA — Air Force/Army/Coast Guard. 2026 BAH rates for the multi-service installation on Cape Cod; elevated Massachusetts coastal market rates.

- [Yokota Air Base](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/yokota-air-base): Fussa, Japan — Air Force. OCONUS installation — members receive Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA), not BAH. Headquarters for U.S. Forces Japan in the western Tokyo metropolitan area.

- [Kadena Air Base](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/kadena-air-base): Okinawa, Japan — Air Force/Multi-branch. OCONUS installation — members receive OHA, not BAH. Largest U.S. Air Force base in Asia and keystone of Pacific air defense.

- [Camp Humphreys (K-6)](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/camp-humphreys): Pyeongtaek, South Korea — Army/Air Force. OCONUS installation — members receive OHA, not BAH. Largest U.S. overseas military base in the world and headquarters of U.S. Forces Korea.

- [Ramstein Air Base](https://www.milpaytools.com/bah/ramstein-air-base): Ramstein-Miesenbach, Germany — Air Force/Army. OCONUS installation — members receive OHA, not BAH. Hub of U.S. military operations in Europe and headquarters of USAFE-AFAFRICA.

## Blog

- [How Much Does an E-5 Really Make in 2026?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/how-much-does-an-e5-really-make-2026): Complete E-5 compensation breakdown including base pay ($3,946.80/month), BAH by location, BAS, tax advantages, and civilian salary equivalent.

- [VA Disability Math Explained](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/va-disability-math-explained): Step-by-step explanation of VA combined rating formula with examples showing why 50% + 30% = 70% (not 80%), bilateral factor, and 2026 compensation rates.

- [2026 BAH Rates Complete Guide](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/bah-rates-2026-complete-guide): Comprehensive guide to 2026 BAH rates including rates for 10 major installations, highest/lowest areas, rate protection rules, and PCS comparison guidance.

- [BRS vs High-3: Which Military Retirement System Is Better?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/brs-vs-high-3-retirement): Side-by-side comparison of BRS and legacy High-3 retirement, with pension math for E-7 at 20 years, TSP matching value, continuation pay, and break-even analysis.

- [The Roth TSP Advantage Nobody Explains to Junior Enlisted](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/roth-tsp-advantage-junior-enlisted): Why the Roth TSP is the optimal choice for junior enlisted, including combat zone triple tax advantage and long-term compounding math.

- [What Civilian Salary Do I Need After the Military?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/what-civilian-salary-do-i-need): Step-by-step comparison of military total compensation to civilian salary equivalents by rank, including healthcare replacement and tax-free allowance grossup.

- [Are You Financially Ready to Leave the Military?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/are-you-financially-ready-to-leave-the-military): Comprehensive guide to the transition readiness decision. Covers the three-factor readiness test (income surplus ≥ $500/month after healthcare replacement, emergency fund ≥ 6 months, VA claim filed or retirement making VA moot), why healthcare is the most underestimated transition cost ($1,400–$2,000/month for a family on the open market vs. $0 on active-duty TRICARE Prime), why TSP doesn't count as emergency fund (10% penalty + ordinary income tax before 59½), and how VA BDD filing before separation can close the income gap from day one. Includes a worked example (E-6, 10 years, JBSA, $75K target salary, 40% VA rating) showing a $374/month surplus — Not Yet verdict due to 2.5-month emergency fund runway.

- [File for VA Disability Before You Separate](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/file-va-disability-before-separation): How the BDD program works, why filing on active duty produces better outcomes, and the lifetime value of VA disability compensation.

- [Military Tax Advantages Most Service Members Miss](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/military-tax-advantages): BAH/BAS exclusions, combat zone tax exclusion, Roth TSP deployment triple advantage, state domicile strategy, and EITC eligibility for junior enlisted.

- [Post-9/11 GI Bill Explained: What It's Actually Worth in 2026](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/post-911-gi-bill-explained-2026): Complete breakdown of GI Bill Chapter 33 — tuition coverage (100% in-state public, $30,908.34/year private cap), monthly housing allowance by ZIP code, books stipend, eligibility tiers by service length, Forever GI Bill expiration rules, and transfer-to-dependents requirements.

- [GI Bill vs Tuition Assistance: Which to Use First](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/gi-bill-vs-tuition-assistance): Strategic guide to sequencing TA and GI Bill — why using GI Bill on active duty wastes the $83,000+ housing allowance, TA limits ($250/credit, $4,500/year), and how to preserve GI Bill months for post-separation use.

- [GI Bill Housing Allowance: Why Your School's ZIP Code Matters More Than Tuition](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/gi-bill-housing-allowance-zip-code): GI Bill MHA equals E-5 with-dependents BAH at the school's ZIP code — ranging from $1,100/month in rural areas to $5,000+/month in high-cost cities. Covers hybrid enrollment rules, August 1 update cycle, and part-time proration.

- [VR&E (Chapter 31) vs GI Bill: The Benefit Most Veterans Don't Know About](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/vre-chapter-31-vs-gi-bill): Veteran Readiness and Employment covers unlimited tuition, full books/equipment, and matching housing allowance — without depleting GI Bill months. Eligibility requires 10%+ VA rating and employment barrier. Includes 48-month combined ceiling and application process.

- [Should I Stay to 20 Years? What MPRs actually cover (roof 2+ year life, functional HVAC/plumbing/electrical, lead paint on pre-1978 homes, no active pest damage, sound foundation) vs. what doesn't fail (cosmetic issues, dated finishes, deferred maintenance). When VA makes sense (eligible borrowers, limited cash, disability exemption, long hold, competitive rate). - [VA Loan Assumptions: How They Work, Who Can Assume, and What Happens to Your Entitlement](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/va-loan-assumptions-explained): VA loans are assumable since the program began — buyer takes over seller's existing loan at original rate and remaining term. Both veterans and non-veterans can assume; buyer must qualify with the servicer. Critical entitlement mechanics: VA-eligible buyer who formally substitutes their entitlement releases the seller's entitlement; non-veteran or veteran without substitution leaves seller's entitlement tied to the assumed loan until payoff. 0.50% assumption funding fee on remaining balance (same as IRRRL). Step-by-step assumption process — servicer approval (not VA direct), 45–90+ day timeline. Gap between purchase price and remaining balance is the primary practical barrier; can be bridged with cash, second mortgage, or seller financing. Payment comparison example: $300K at 3.25% = $1,306/mo P&I vs. $300K at 6.5% = $1,896/mo ($590/month savings, payback in under 3 months on a $1,400 assumption fee). When assumptions make sense for buyers (large rate differential, manageable gap) and sellers (below-market rate as selling advantage, VA-eligible buyer available for entitlement substitution). VA assumption vs IRRRL vs new VA purchase loan — three distinct transactions explained.

- [How to Read Your LES: Every Line on Your Military Pay Stub Explained](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/how-to-read-your-les): Comprehensive reference guide to the Leave and Earnings Statement — all 30+ line items explained across six sections: Entitlements (BASE PAY, BAH, BAS, HFP/IDP, FSA, HDP, COLA, DLA, special pays), Deductions (FITW, SITW, FICA, SGLI, TSP, AFRH, TRICARE, mid-month pay, MGIB), Allotments, Summary (net pay reconciliation), Leave balance (use-or-lose threshold, sell-back at separation), and YTD tax data. - [Can You Use Tuition Assistance and the GI Bill at the Same Time?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/tuition-assistance-and-gi-bill-together): Quick-answer post. TA covers up to $250/credit hour and $4,500/year for tuition only. GI Bill Top-Up can fill the gap above TA but uses entitlement months. On active duty, GI Bill's MHA isn't paid (you already receive BAH), so spending GI Bill months on active duty wastes its most valuable component. Use TA first; save GI Bill for post-separation when the housing allowance adds real value. Branch-specific TA portals and approval processes.

- [Is SGLI Enough Life Insurance for Military Members?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/is-sgli-enough-life-insurance): Quick-answer post. SGLI provides $500,000 at $26/month with no medical underwriting — highly accessible. Whether enough depends on dependents, debts, mortgage, and income replacement need. Common benchmark: 10–12x annual income. Single no-dependents: likely sufficient. Family with mortgage and single income: may need more. SGLI terminates 120 days after separation; VGLI conversion available within 240 days without health exam but premiums escalate steeply with age. Private term life purchased on active duty locks in rates while healthy.

- [How Does Deployment Pay Work? What Changes When You Deploy?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/how-deployment-pay-works): Quick-answer post. Combat Zone Tax Exclusion eliminates federal income tax on all enlisted base pay in qualifying combat zones (officers capped at E-9 max). Hostile Fire Pay / IDP: $225/month. Family Separation Allowance: $300/month if separated from dependents 30+ days. FICA still applies. Savings Deposit Program: 10% guaranteed return on up to $10,000. Roth TSP during CZTE months: triple tax advantage (excluded going in, grows tax-free, withdrawn tax-free). BAH, BAS, and base pay continue unchanged.

- [Do Both Military Spouses Get BAH? Dual Military Housing Rules](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/dual-military-bah-rules): Both members receive BAH. With children co-located, only one gets the with-dependents rate — and the member with the larger with/without gap should claim, not necessarily the higher-ranking member (worked San Diego and Fort Campbell 2026 DTMO examples show the optimal claimant flips by market). Without children: both get the without-dependents rate. At different duty stations, dependent assignment follows where the children live. Covers the core claiming rules, how to find the optimal configuration, equal-rank couples, geographically separated couples, and whether BAH counts as mortgage income.

- [How Much Does a PCS Move Cost Out of Pocket?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/pcs-out-of-pocket-costs): Quick-answer post. Military covers travel pay, mileage, per diem, TLE, and household goods — but service members typically spend $1,000–$5,000+ out of pocket. DLA for E-6 with dependents: $3,548.02 (no receipts). TLE limits: 10 days old station + 10 days new station = 14 combined CONUS max. Common gaps: security deposits, gap lodging, per diem shortfalls, reimbursement lag. PPM/DITY: pocket the difference between government estimate and actual cost ($2,000–$5,000 on longer routes). Recommend $2,000–$3,000 PCS cash buffer separate from emergency fund.

- [What Is the SCRA and How Does It Protect Military Members?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/what-is-scra-military-protection): Quick-answer post. SCRA caps interest on pre-service debt at 6% (written request + orders required). Only pre-service debt — not accounts opened during service. Many major issuers voluntarily go further (0% rates, fee waivers). Lease termination: 50+ mile PCS or 90+ day deployment. State tax protection: SCRA preserves legal residence state as the taxing state for military income. SCRA does not apply to post-service debts. Protections generally end 180 days after separation for consumer debt.

- [What Happens to Your TSP When You Leave the Military?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/what-happens-to-tsp-after-military): Quick-answer post. TSP stays open after separation — no action required. Cannot contribute after leaving (unless returning to federal service). Can change fund allocations and make interfund transfers. Options: leave in TSP (lowest fees), roll to IRA (more investment options, usually higher fees), or withdraw (taxes + 10% penalty before 59½). Direct rollover avoids taxes and penalties. Roth TSP qualified withdrawals remain tax-free — don't cash out and lose that advantage. BRS government match vests after 2 years.

- [How Do You Read a Military LES? Key Abbreviations Explained](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/les-abbreviations-explained): Quick-answer post. Key abbreviations: FITW (Federal Income Tax Withholding — on base pay and taxable pays, not BAH/BAS), SITW (state tax — should match legal residence state, not duty station), FICA (Social Security + Medicare, applies even during CZTE), SGLI ($26/month for $500K in 2026), AFRH ($0.50/month for all members, not an error). Mid-month pay appears as deduction on end-of-month LES — not money taken, just accounting reconciliation. Most costly errors: wrong BAH dependency status, TSP below 5%, wrong state SITW.

- [What Is the Difference Between BRS and High-3 Military Retirement?](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/brs-vs-high-3-difference): Quick-answer post. High-3: 2.5% × years × High-36 average = 50% at 20 years. BRS: 2.0% × years × High-36 average = 40% at 20 years, plus 1% auto TSP contribution + up to 4% matching (5% total government contribution) + continuation pay at 8–12 years. E-7 at 20 years: High-3 pension ~$3,050/month vs BRS ~$2,440/month — $610/month difference. About 80% of members don't reach 20 years; BRS provides vested TSP value regardless. Post-2018 entrants automatically in BRS; 2018 opt-in irrevocable.

- [Which States Don't Tax Military Pay? 2026 State-by-State Guide](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/military-tax-advantages-by-state): Complete state-by-state breakdown of how state income taxes apply to active-duty military pay. Covers the 9 states with no income tax (Alaska, Florida, Nevada, NH, SD, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wyoming), states with full military pay exemptions, states with partial exemptions, and states that tax military pay without a general exemption (including California's aggressive approach to resident taxation). Explains how SCRA determines which state can tax you, the process for changing state of legal residence (DD Form 2058), MSRRA spouse considerations, and common mistakes. Includes a full 50-state reference table with treatment and notes for each state and DC.

- [TSP for Beginners: What Happens If You Never Change Your Settings](https://www.milpaytools.com/blog/tsp-for-beginners-what-happens-if-you-do-nothing): Explains what actually happens in your TSP account if you never log in — BRS auto-enrollment at 5% into an age-appropriate Lifecycle Fund, older accounts defaulting to the G Fund, what the G Fund returns vs. inflation (roughly 2–4% per year, barely keeping pace), how the L Fund glide path works, and why the fund choice can produce a $200,000–$400,000+ difference in balance by retirement from the same contribution amounts. Covers the full BRS government match structure (1% auto + match on first 3% dollar-for-dollar + 50% on next 2% = up to 5% government total), Roth vs. Traditional decision for junior enlisted, how to change contribution rate in myPay vs. fund allocation in TSP.gov (two separate systems), and what to do at each career stage.

## Data Sources

- 2026 Military Pay Tables: Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS)
- 2026 BAH Rates: Defense Travel Management Office (DTMO) official ASCII data download
- VA Disability Compensation Rates: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA.gov), effective December 1, 2025 (2.8% COLA)
- TSP Contribution Limits: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and TSP.gov
- Healthcare Cost Benchmarks: KFF Employer Health Benefits Survey 2025, Healthcare.gov benchmark pricing
- TRICARE Premiums: TRICARE.mil, effective January 1, 2026

## About

Built by Dan Stevens — grew up on Air Force bases worldwide as the son of a 20-year Air Force veteran, now an NMLS-licensed mortgage industry professional. 18 calculators, 64 blog posts, 9 comprehensive guides, 200+ BAH station pages, a transition financial roadmap, and a printable TAP student worksheet — all multi-LLM fact-checked against official government sources and verified with a Playwright test suite.
